card.summary: Protect a small server, at no cost: 1 server, 30 players online, 1 backend, 5 domains, Anti-bot, bans and whitelist, Basic support

free_tier.stated: Protect a small server, at no cost: 1 server, 30 players online, 1 backend, 5 domains, Anti-bot, bans and whitelist, Basic support

egress.terms: No bandwidth caps and no overage charges on any plan; player counts follow your plan; ingress: tcp

record.interface_detail: Dashboard at floodguard.xyz/dashboard, Discord login, no separate password.
record.tooling: DNS record in the dashboard, PROXY protocol enabled on the origin
record.chaining: DNS in front of a public origin; needs the origin reachable from the internet, so it does not give a private VM a public address.

limits.value: free plan allows 30 players online on 1 server and 1 backend
Bedrock and voice chat appear as add-ons on the Pro card and are absent from the Free card; the docs describe a Bedrock add-on without naming which plans may buy it

record.binding_note: Bandwidth is declared uncapped on every plan, so a 1 TiB/month figure never meets a counter. The constraint that stops a caller first is the plan class itself: the Free card lists no Bedrock add-on while the Pro card does, so on the pages read there is no UDP port to consume the allowance.

identity_cost.detail: Sign in with Discord: 'Open the dashboard and sign in with Discord. There is no separate password.'

record.reliability_note: Uncapped bandwidth plus a 30-player cap; no published enforcement policy.
record.confidence_note: Free plan fields, the uncapped-bandwidth sentence and the Discord-only signin are all on first-party pages read. An actual transfer test would be needed to see whether the uncapped claim survives 1 TiB/month.

evidence.proved: Free plan: GBP 0, 1 server, 30 players online, 1 backend, 5 domains, anti-bot, bans and whitelist; Pro lists 'Bedrock and voice chat add-ons'
Unlimited bandwidth, no caps and no overage charges on any plan; player counts follow the plan
Sign-in is Discord only, and Bedrock appears as an add-on section that only exists once Bedrock is set up

record.notes: DDoS protection for Minecraft Java servers. Free plan includes unmetered bandwidth for up to 30 concurrent players; UDP and Bedrock proxying require paid plans.

extras.wg_detail: No WireGuard offering, and no free UDP port.
extras.volume_stated: No bandwidth caps and no overage charges on any plan; player counts follow your plan
extras.transit_note: FloodGuard's four locations proxy the traffic
